summary: The audit checks 45 units at Stanford: two math courses from different areas, one depth area for at least 9 units, two breadth courses from areas outside your depth, and approved graduate electives to reach 39 units, plus 15 units of ME lecture courses and one lab course (those two may overlap with your other courses). Courses for these requirements must be letter graded unless no letter grade is offered, and each course counts toward only one requirement. Units below the 100 level and ME 299A/B do not count. Checked by hand: your advisor approves the electives, the 3.0 GPA, the 15 ME units, that no IntroSem counts, and the Fluid Mechanics breadth exclusion the Bulletin names without a course number.

ltHZYsf1.why: Moves under the 39-unit group (see v5SgGqWB) as one two-course list.

v5SgGqWB.why: Approved Electives: "Additional graduate (numbered 200+) engineering, math, and science courses will bring the total number of units to at least 39. The student's advisor must approve all of these units." Depth: "A depth cluster or area comprises at least nine units (2-3 courses)." Breadth: "Two courses are required from the list of eligible breadth courses from area(s) outside your depth. They can come from the same area or two different areas. If you select two Data Science classes for your breadth, at least one of those must have an ME course number." The stored breadth rule required two different areas, which the text does not; it is now one list of every breadth area's courses with at most one non-ME Data Science course (CS 229 / STATS 229 is also a Robotics breadth course, so it is not capped). Breadth must come from outside the depth ("from area(s) outside your depth"; each area: "If depth is Dynamics, select any two courses from one or two of the other areas"), so each depth area is now a path with its own breadth list: every other area's breadth courses, MEMS and Data Science. A course also on another area's list stays eligible. The single shared list had let ME 334 count as breadth for a Dynamics depth. Approved electives are courses the student moves in toward the 39 units; their caps ("no more than six units may come from independent study ... no more than three units may come from seminars") name courses the Bulletin text lost. Grading: "All courses taken for the Mechanical Engineering master's degree must be taken for a letter grade, except for Unrestricted Electives or when grades are not an option (e.g., seminar and research courses)."

children.desc:
Additional graduate (numbered 200+) engineering, math, and science courses will bring the total number of units to at least 39. The student’s advisor must approve all of these units. Graduate engineering, math, and science courses are typically approved. 100-level CS courses that satisfy the program program are also allowed.
Of these 39 units, no more than six units may come from independent study (course and course), and no more than three units may come from seminars. Students planning to pursue the PhD should discuss taking course or course during the master’s program with their academic advisor. course and course/course may not be included in approved electives.
Students may use one of the following courses as an approved elective without petition: course, course, course, course.
children.notes: Note: Students participating in course or course should make the necessary arrangements with a faculty member. In addition, the faculty member and the student should determine the number of units for the course. course and course may only be taken on a credit / no credit basis. If a student takes an independent study in a different department, the grading option should be credit/no credit.

YHam3s35.why: "Students must take a minimum of 15 units of coursework in mechanical engineering. Only courses with a 200+ ME course number and lecture (LEC) designation are considered mechanical engineering topics ... Research (independent study) units and seminars cannot count toward the 15 units of ME coursework." These are courses counted for the requirements above, not extra ones; the lecture designation is not in the data, so the student moves the courses in and they still count where they are.

AytFmDhV.why: "These courses will bring the total number of units submitted for the MS degree to 45." The 45 units are program.unitsMin; "Unrestricted electives must be level 100+ and may be taken credit/no credit."

mADM43CG.why: "Within the courses satisfying the requirements above, there must be at least one graduate-level course with a laboratory component." The lab course is one already counted above. Directed study with lab work needs ME Student Services approval and is moved in by hand.
